# GAMBLR.open

![Build](https://github.com/morinlab/GAMBLR.open/actions/workflows/build_check.yaml/badge.svg)![R
package
version](https://img.shields.io/github/r-package/v/morinlab/GAMBLR.open)![Commit
activity](https://img.shields.io/github/commit-activity/m/morinlab/GAMBLR.open)![Last
commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/morinlab/GAMBLR.open)

Hello GAMBLRs!

![](GAMBLR.open.png)

Database, mining, manipulation and convenience functions for working
with genomic data of mature B-cell lymphomas. This package is a wrapper
that provides a convenient one-stop access to load the following
packages from the GAMBLR family:

- [GAMBLR.open](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open) - this package

- [GAMBLR.data](https://github.com/morinlab/GAMBLR.data) - collection of
  genomic data for analysis of Mature B-cell neoplasms

- [GAMBLR.helpers](https://github.com/morinlab/GAMBLR.helpers) - a set
  of low-level functions for data operation

- [GAMBLR.utils](https://github.com/morinlab/GAMBLR.utils) - higher
  level set of functions to operate on genomic data

- [GAMBLR.viz](https://github.com/morinlab/GAMBLR.viz) - set of
  functions used mostly for visualizations

- [GAMBLR.predict](https://github.com/morinlab/GAMBLR.predict) -
  collection of functions and helpers to classify B-cell lymphomas

# Package index

## get\_ functions

- [`get_all_coding_ssm()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_all_coding_ssm.md)
  : Get all Coding SSMs
- [`get_ashm_count_matrix()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_ashm_count_matrix.md)
  : Get ASHM Count Matrix.
- [`get_cn_segments()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_cn_segments.md)
  : Get CN Segments.
- [`get_cnv_and_ssm_status()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_cnv_and_ssm_status.md)
  : Get CNV and coding SSM combined status
- [`get_coding_ssm()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_coding_ssm.md)
  : Get Coding SSMs
- [`get_coding_ssm_status()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_coding_ssm_status.md)
  : Get Coding SSM Status.
- [`get_gambl_metadata()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_gambl_metadata.md)
  : Get GAMBL Metadata.
- [`get_manta_sv()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_manta_sv.md)
  : Get Manta SVs
- [`get_sample_cn_segments()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_sample_cn_segments.md)
  : Get Sample CN Segments.
- [`get_ssm_by_patients()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_ssm_by_patients.md)
  : Get SSM By Patients.
- [`get_ssm_by_region()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_ssm_by_region.md)
  : Get SSM By Region.
- [`get_ssm_by_regions()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_ssm_by_regions.md)
  : Get SSM By Regions.
- [`get_ssm_by_sample()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_ssm_by_sample.md)
  : Get SSM By Sample.
- [`get_ssm_by_samples()`](https://morinlab.github.io/GAMBLR.open/reference/get_ssm_by_samples.md)
  : Get SSM By Samples.
